name: psd-ecommerce
description: PSD's DTC ecommerce reporting agents. Pull Polar Analytics data, produce skimmable HTML + PDF reports in the house style, save to the project reports folder, and optionally log action items to Asana. Covers review, ads, retention, merch and ops weekly decks (.pptx), pricing, CRO, finance, returns, forecast, sale-recap, web daily flash, cart/page/PDP/speed audits, and /mix-match-report (Gift Builder HTML + Excel).
